# Whale Wallet

> A personal finance app for people in the Philippines. It shows what is safe to spend each day until payday and keeps cards, e-wallets, bills, subscriptions, loans, savings pods and net worth in one place. Free during early access. It tracks money; it does not hold or move it.

## Features
- Safe-to-spend number and payday forecast
- Bills, subscriptions and loans that stay overdue until marked paid, with notes
- Who Owes You: record cash lent, with email reminders to the borrower
- Whale Chat: log money by typing or voice (English, Tagalog, Taglish)
- Receipt and transfer screenshot reading
- Savings pods, side income, daily email digest, data import and export
